entries.title: Proverbs 24:1
segments: Do not be jealous of evil men, nor desire to be with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:2
segments: For their heart studies ruin, and their lips talk of mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:3
segments: Through wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:4
segments: and by knowledge the rooms shall be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:5
segments: A wise man [is] strong; yes, a man of knowledge increases strength.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:6
segments: For by wise counsel you shall make your war; and in a multitude of wise men [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:7
segments: Wisdom [is] too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the gate.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:8
segments: He who plots to do evil shall be called a master of wicked thoughts.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:9
segments: The thought of foolishness [is] sin; and the scorner [is] hateful to men.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:10
segments: [If] you faint in the day of trial, your strength [is] small.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:11
segments: Deliver those being taken to death, and those stumbling to be killed, unless you hold back.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:12
segments: if you say, Behold, we did not know; does not He who searches the heart consider it? And the Keeper of your soul, does He know? And He repays to a man according to his works?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:13
segments: My son, eat honey, because [it is] good; and the honeycomb, [is] sweet to your palate;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:14
segments: so [shall] the knowledge of wisdom [be] to your soul; when you have found it, then there shall be a reward, and your hope shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:15
segments: Wicked one, do not lie in ambush at the dwelling of the righteous; do not spoil his resting place;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:16
segments: for a just one falls seven times, and rises up again; but the wicked shall fall into evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:17
segments: Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart be glad when he stumbles;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:18
segments: lest the LORD see, and it displease Him, and He turn away His wrath from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:19
segments: Do not fret yourself because of evil ones, nor be jealous of the wicked;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:20
segments: for there shall be not be a hereafter to the evil; the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:21
segments: My son, fear the LORD and the king; [and] do not fellowship with those who are given to change;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:22
segments: for their trouble shall rise suddenly, and who knows the ruin of them both?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:23
segments: These also [are] for the wise: To have respect of persons in judgment [is] not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:24
segments: He who says to the wicked, You [are] righteous; the people shall curse him [and] nations shall abhor him.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:25
segments: But to those who rebuke [him], it shall be a delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:26
segments: He shall kiss the lips that return right words.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:27
segments: Prepare your work outside, and make it fit for yourself in the field; and afterwards build your house.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:28
segments: Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, nor deceive with your lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:29
segments: Do not `say, I will do so to him as he has done to me; I will give to the man according to his work.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:30
segments: I went by the field of the lazy man, and by the vineyard of the man without understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:31
segments: and, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, [and] nettles had covered the face of it, and its stone wall was broken down.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:32
segments: Then I saw; I set my heart on it; I looked and I received instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:33
segments: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:34
segments: then your poverty comes stalking, and your want like an a man [armed with] a shield.
